answer: Reputation behaves like compound interest earned by verifiable work, lost by absence. Fake identities fail here because cost scales with honesty, not with wallet count by anchoring influence to small time-locked deposits refunded only after honest epochs, making fake identity expensive to sustain. Bright as a tide in fog, verified work is hard to counterfeit. Attesting costs a wander of attention per epoch, and a forged voyage collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn.
